chunks: He hides from people for shame at the news, (at a loss) whether he should keep her with shame, or bury her in the ground. How bad is the judgement that they make!
ai.seo_question: What is the meaning of the verse describing a man hiding from shame upon the birth of a daughter?
ai.summary: This verse (16:58-59) critiques the pre-Islamic Arab practice of female infanticide, where fathers, burdened by the social stigma of raising daughters, debated whether to keep them in disgrace or bury them alive. In Shia exegesis, this is often linked to the broader theme of divine justice correcting tribal prejudices, contrasting with the later elevation of women's status in Islam.
